tagline: Wynn Resorts is a designer, developer, and operator of integrated luxury resorts featuring world-class gaming, hospitality, and entertainment experiences
hero_kpi_rationale: Casino revenues are the primary driver of Wynn Resorts' business, representing 61.8% of operating revenues in 2025, an increase of 3.5% compared to 2024

kpis.name: Casino Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by gaming and gambling activities
kpis.description: Casino revenues represent the primary revenue source for Wynn Resorts

kpis.name: Non-Casino Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by non-gaming activities including rooms, food and beverage, and entertainment
kpis.description: Non-casino revenues include room revenues ($1,141M), food and beverage revenues ($1,038M), and entertainment and retail activities ($549M)

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to Wynn Resorts, Limited
kpis.description: Net income is affected by variations in revenues, operating costs, and income tax provisions

kpis.name: Operating Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total operating revenues combining casino and non-casino revenues
kpis.description: Total operating revenues represent the sum of casino and non-casino revenues

kpis.name: Total Revenue

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is sensitive to reductions in consumer discretionary spending. A negative macroeconomic environment could have a significant impact on its business and operating results.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to extensive regulation in gaming and financial services. Non-compliance with these regulations could have a significant impact on its operations.

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation is critical to its business in the luxury and entertainment industry. A deterioration in reputation could have a negative impact on its business.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions, travel restrictions, and foreign exchange policies could have a significant impact on the company's business, particularly its operations in Macau.

risks.title: Concentration Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is entirely dependent on a few resorts for its business (Macau, Las Vegas, Boston). This concentration makes it vulnerable to changes in local economic and regulatory conditions.

risks.title: Key Personnel Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company depends heavily on its executive officers and key employees to maintain its operational standards and luxury reputation.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation risks relating to civil liability, regulatory compliance, and commercial contracts.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks related to the management of sensitive customer data and its critical computer systems.

risks.title: Debt Dependency Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company carries significant debt burden which affects its operational flexibility and debt service obligations.

ai_positioning.summary: Wynn Resorts does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
